policies.hardBudget: 0 paid API calls, no GPU/cloud provisioning, no purchase, no deployment, no automatic model downloading.
policies.meaningOfFree: OSS source availability does not guarantee zero compute cost; public GitHub Actions may be free within product terms, private runners and commercial providers can bill.
policies.activation: Only installed/validated tools in the target specialized repository can execute. Inventory never auto-installs a tool.
policies.runtimeScope: No additional orchestration engines installed into gentaron/agent-runner.
policies.adoptionProof: Runtime fields are evidence labels (observed code, draft PR, catalog only) and must not be inferred from user reports.
